name: Raikou no Taimashi Nanaho ~Injin Fukkatsu~
original_name: 雷光の退魔師ナナホ～淫神復活～
source:
Nanaho "taimashi of lightning" gets swayed by the overwhelming horror! Millay is a beautiful police woman who investigates on serial missing cases.

Her investigation leads her to suspect a private school named Watayama which sits in a certain gloomy town.
Then a mysterious pretty girl, Nanaho, shows up before her as a hunter of the evil.

[From [url=http://eng.dlsite.com/work/=/product_id/RE069950.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
“雷光退魔师”七穗在压倒性的恐怖面前动摇！米蕾是一位美丽的女警察，正在调查一连串失踪案件。

调查使她开始怀疑某座阴郁城镇中的私立学校“绵山学园”。
随后，一名神秘美少女七穗出现在她面前，自称邪恶猎手。

[摘自[url=http://eng.dlsite.com/work/=/product_id/RE069950.html]DLsite English[/url]]
